notes.content: I made more bad songs that no one but me could possibly like. Enjoy. (Sad Cap, Bored Nights, More Than Brick).

notes.title: Updates to UI Scaling and Supported Resoltuions
notes.content:
Changed how UIs are scaled throughout the game. Should be better now? Also changed what resolutions are supported. Before it was hard-coded at a few 16:9 resolutions. Now it should just pull whatever resolutions your monitor/screen supports. Anything that isn't 16:9 though will likely have black bars as the "game" is still 16:9.

Note: The resolutions that the game pulls will most likely all be the same aspect ration as your monitors native resolution. So, if you have a 16:9 monitor, you would likely only see 16:9 resolutions. If you have a 16:10 monitor, you'll see 16:10 resolutions and so on.

This will either fix a few issues or completely break everything. Only time will tell.

notes.title: Changes to make passing better or something
notes.content:
Made some changes to how passing works in GRF. Before, if you passed, the ball would be thrown directly to where the receiving goblin was when you pressed the pass button. Now, it will try and lead the receiving goblin based on the receiving goblin's movement direction* and speed

* For singleplayer and 1v1 it actually uses the direction you are currently moving as the thrower, since you now immediately switch to the receiving goblin so their movement will be what your previous movement was. Sorry if that makes no sense

notes.title: Map Maker for Golf is LIVE
notes.content:
The map maker/custom hole maker is now LIVE on the main branch of Goblin Rules Football! You can now create your own custom golf courses as either a "regular" golf course or a "minigolf" course. Custom golf courses can be uploaded to the steam Workshop in game. If you join a game running a map you aren't subscribed to in the workshop, you will be prompt if you want to download the map from the workshop. 

Wow! Whoa!

There are some other changes as well. But that is t he main one. Hopefully it works correctly.

Changes
- Map maker for custom golf course
- Updated water, deep rough, and rough textures in the Golf Mode
- changed how "terrain type" ball is on is detected
- changed how game finds nearest land outside of water player's ball landed in
- a couple new songs I think

notes.title: Music can be turned off correctly (maybe) and kick after attempt checks
notes.content:
- Updated music manager so music should be able to turn on and off correctly...
- added some checks to kick after attempts so, hopefully, kick after attempts can't both be "blocked" and "the kick was good" at the same time. Who knows if it actually works though

notes.title: UI Fixes and new minigolf holes. Also flowers
notes.content:
Fixed an issue with the settings menu in the GRF tutorial that a player brought up. Should be fixed now.

I also changed holes 8 and 9 in the minigolf course. They are new holes and no longer just a cut and paste of two tee off challenges. They have little holes that you hit the ball into so it travels down a pipe and stuff. Crazy. Also added some flowers to the new holes to jazz things up a bit.

notes.title: Golf Mode Official and on Main Branch
notes.content:
Now that I finally made some more swing animations to account for different directions, I am updating the main branch of the game to include Golf Mode! It also includes the "smooth sync" stuff I did for football multilplayer to make that smoother.

So, [b]Update Notes[/b]
[list]
[*] "Smooth Sync" added to football multiplayer. Should make player movement "smoother" in multiplayer games
[*] Brand new golf mode added! You can now choose between playing football, or golf!
[/list]

notes.title: Aim points and other things
notes.content:
Added "aim points" to each hole. Basically they are suggested areas of where to aim on the hole. Can cycle through them or use the numbers 1/2/3/4/5 as shorts if using keyboard. When you select aim point your character will automatically aim right at the point. Meant to make setting up shots quicker than before.

Also fixed an issue with key rebinding for golf causing crashes. Well I hope it's fixed at least. I also accidentally removed the "pings" you hear after perfect power/accuracy hit submissions and that should be added back now.
